statement: The actual cusp orbit body has a marked product model E_I1 times S1; its boundary gamma circle action extends freely to its interior, giving an ambient isotopy to the actual annular map whose fixed-sphere trace is the nodal normalization sweep. The gamma-u-w three-torus is a primitive nonbounding H3 generator.
notes: Transport is prescribed on the boundary and unitary-linear in fixed normal tubes. Interior raw orbits and q need not be preserved. The fixed sphere moves under the extending circle action, and no numerical J or Theta7 class follows.
